name: Data.hasRigidLabels_spaceY_zero
summary: Apply occurringLabels_subsingleton with L the composite lift iota from Y_0 to the definite Y_m for the trivial twist: injective, spherical eigenvalues off the level depending only on p, and parahoric type at x with psi = 1 and further characters the powers of omega_x, which are pairwise distinct and of order dividing M_omega.

steps.claim: Let p be an eigensystem and x a chosen place.
steps.lean:
fun p x ↦ by
  refine D.occurringLabels_subsingleton _ (D.iotaAtLevel_injective 1) (D.exists_isSphericalWith_iota
    p).choose_spec x _ 1 (fun y ↦ ⟨blockNumber_eq_zero _, fun k g h e ↦ congr($(D.algFormRep_iota _
    _ y _ _ (reduceFamily_atSplit (.inl x) k) (Sum.rec ?_ (by simp)) ?_).1).trans
    (by rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (.inl x)] <;> simp_all [-Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Matrix.toSquareBlock, Matrix.toSquareBlockProp, -Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply];
        rfl)⟩) (fun a b h ↦ by_contra fun e ↦ ((D.omega_zpow_ne_one (a - b)) _).2 x.2.2.1 ?_)
    (by simp) fun _ ↦ D.omega_zpow_mul_pow_eq_one _ (one_pow _)
  iterate 2 exact (by cases eq_or_ne · x <;> aesop)
  simp_all [TameChar.pow, (1 : D.MFoldTwist).1.ψ_eq_one x.2.1 nofun, chosen, sub_eq_add_neg,
    zpow_add]

steps.claim: Apply occurringLabels_subsingleton to V = spaceY(D, 0) with L = iotaAtLevel(D, 1), the composite of the m theta lifts to the definite Y_m for the trivial twist.
steps.lean:
refine D.occurringLabels_subsingleton _ (D.iotaAtLevel_injective 1) (D.exists_isSphericalWith_iota
    p).choose_spec x _ 1 (fun y ↦ ⟨blockNumber_eq_zero _, fun k g h e ↦ congr($(D.algFormRep_iota _
    _ y _ _ (reduceFamily_atSplit (.inl x) k) (Sum.rec ?_ (by simp)) ?_).1).trans
    (by rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (.inl x)] <;> simp_all [-Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Matrix.toSquareBlock, Matrix.toSquareBlockProp, -Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply];
        rfl)⟩) (fun a b h ↦ by_contra fun e ↦ ((D.omega_zpow_ne_one (a - b)) _).2 x.2.2.1 ?_)
    (by simp) fun _ ↦ D.omega_zpow_mul_pow_eq_one _ (one_pow _)

steps.claim: There is a family F such that the lift of every form of the p-part is spherical at each split place w off the chosen places with eigenvalue F_w.
Take the place x, psi = 1, and the family chi of further characters to be determined (the residue characters of the blocks of Y_m).

For every y, L(y) has parahoric type at x: block 0 is the first block, and for k integral at x, block triangular mod x with block 0 equal to g, the right translate of L(y) is prod_l chi_l(det k_ll) L(g y) (algFormRep_iota), the product reducing to the factor at x; two conditions on the other places are left.
steps.lean:
(fun y ↦ ⟨blockNumber_eq_zero _, fun k g h e ↦ congr($(D.algFormRep_iota _
    _ y _ _ (reduceFamily_atSplit (.inl x) k) (Sum.rec ?_ (by simp)) ?_).1).trans
    (by rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (.inl x)] <;> simp_all [-Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Matrix.toSquareBlock, Matrix.toSquareBlockProp, -Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply];
        rfl)⟩)

steps.claim: The characters chi_l (powers omega_x^l) are pairwise distinct: omega_x^(a-b) is nontrivial at the chosen place x for a, b distinct in range; one condition is left.
steps.lean: (fun a b h ↦ by_contra fun e ↦ ((D.omega_zpow_ne_one (a - b)) _).2 x.2.2.1 ?_)

steps.claim: psi = 1 satisfies psi^(M_omega) = 1, and every chi_l^(M_omega) = 1.
The two conditions at the other places hold by distinguishing whether a place equals x.
steps.lean: iterate 2 exact (by cases eq_or_ne · x <;> aesop)

steps.claim: The remaining condition: for the trivial twist the tame part is 1 at x, so the character of block l is omega_x^l and the difference of two of them is omega_x^(a-b).
steps.lean:
simp_all [TameChar.pow, (1 : D.MFoldTwist).1.ψ_eq_one x.2.1 nofun, chosen, sub_eq_add_neg,
    zpow_add]
